company.name: Amboras
company.shortDescription: Amboras is an AI-native ecommerce platform that enables businesses to build, manage, and optimize online stores through intelligent tools.
company.description: Amboras offers an AI-native ecommerce platform that builds, operates, and optimizes online stores. The platform generates complete storefronts, including layout, branding, product pages, and checkout, from simple text prompts and product data. It includes an AI-driven shop system for managing inventory, orders, and fulfillment, as well as tools for AI SEO, reviews, AI-generated transactional and marketing emails, and built-in analytics. Amboras also provides agentic A/B testing that creates and runs experiments on copy, layout, pricing, and bundles, promoting winning variants automatically. First-party analytics and real-time event tracking are integrated directly into the store backend. The service is designed for merchants who want an all-in-one system to launch new stores, migrate existing stores, and manage day-to-day ecommerce operations with AI assistance.
